events.title: French gendarme occupation
hints: Troops from a co-prince's country marched in after riots over voting rights.
A self-declared king arrived the following year and was swiftly deported.
events.summary: In 1933, after unrest linked to a campaign to widen the franchise, French gendarmes occupied the valleys at the request of the French co-prince's representative. They stayed for a short period and withdrew without annexation.
events.quip: A tiny principality, a very large neighbour, and the quickest crisis of the century.
